sermon.title: God's Magnifical House IV
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In Part IV of “God’s Magnifical House,” Pastor David G. Kincer says the church must be built by the Bible pattern so the fame and glory of Jesus fill the nations, and that every believer is invited to be a priest. He gives four responsibilities of a priest from Deuteronomy 10:8, Numbers 16:9 and Hebrews 9, and says that through the blood of Jesus every believer can enter the holy of holies, minister to the Lord, hear his voice and have the Scriptures opened.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: He says “Deuteronomy 10 18” for the separation of the tribe of Levi, which is Deuteronomy 10:8 (he cites 10:8 correctly later); Deuteronomy 10:8 is shown. The captions read “Psalm 6-3 4” (Psalm 63:4) and “number 69” twice for the words “Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you,” which are Numbers 16:9; these are shown as Psalm 63:4 and Numbers 16:9. He reads Amos 5:25 and continues into 5:26; the second idol name is garbled in the captions and marked [unclear]. He quotes “every jot and tittle” (Matthew 5:18), “the dead praise not the Lord” (Psalm 115:17) and “he that hath an ear” (Revelation 2:7) without naming the reference. He names a well-known woman evangelist whose name is garbled in the captions (marked [unclear], not guessed) and “that other lady” when criticizing theatrical healing practices, and a church member, Mike (transcript only). He says “the catholics are all wrong that priest cannot absolve you from sin,” speaks about Muhammad and Islamic prayer, says he is “not looking for a rapture,” speaks of the church in America “legalizing sin,” and says women have a place in the kingdom; these are his own views and are kept as spoken.

chunks.short_answer: He reads 1 Chronicles 22:5 that the Lord’s house would be magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries, at a time when people did not know about other continents but God did. He says the fame was fulfilled in Luke 5:15, when great multitudes came to hear Jesus and be healed.

scriptures.text_nkjv: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister to Him and to bless in His name, to this day.

faqs.question: What does he say separates Christians from other religions?
faqs.answer: He says we do things because Jesus said to do them and we do them in his name; we follow Jesus, not other religious founders.

faqs.question: Why does he say to praise God now while you are alive?
faqs.answer: He says it is no good to wait till you’re dead, because the Bible says the dead praise not the Lord.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Thus I will bless You while I live; I will lift up my hands in Your name.

faqs.question: Does God say the same thing to every church?
faqs.answer: He says what God is saying in one church would be entirely different from another because the people and their level are different, so we should not try one method for everybody.

scriptures.text_nkjv: “He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the midst of the Paradise of God.” ’

faqs.question: How does he say ministers should be sent out?
faqs.answer: He says it would be nice if ministers were sent out by the Holy Ghost instead of by seminars and Bible colleges, and not just to make it an occupation.

scriptures.text_nkjv: As they ministered to the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Now separate to Me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.” Then, having fasted and prayed, and laid hands on them, they sent them away.

faqs.question: Do women have a place in the kingdom?
faqs.answer: He says the women brought Jesus food and drink, washed his clothes and ministered to him of their substance, so he questions people who say women don’t have a place in the kingdom.

scriptures.text_nkjv: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others who provided for Him from their substance.

faqs.question: Is giving part of ministering to the Lord?
faqs.answer: He says giving to Jesus and to the church to get the word out and help people grow is part of ministering to the Lord, and that mentality changes the attitude you give with.

scriptures.text_nkjv: and Joanna the wife of Chuza, Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others who provided for Him from their substance.

faqs.question: What happened when the veil of the temple was torn?
faqs.answer: He says when Jesus died God tore the curtain from top to bottom, too high for a man to reach, signifying that now not just the high priest but all of us can go in.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Therefore, brethren, having boldness to enter the Holiest by the blood of Jesus,

faqs.question: Where does he say the Scriptures are opened to us?
faqs.answer: He says the scroll of the Scriptures was beside the ark, and if you really want the word opened to you, come into his presence, open the book and he will open your understanding in a still small voice.
